response.message: Astra: The latest revision quoted my guidance instead of showing the comparison itself. Keep attention on your recap’s usefulness: choose a passage you can actually compare with an earlier version and judge whether it adds information or only changes wording. A small comparison is enough if it settles whether another rewrite is worthwhile. If you cannot find the underlying recap, say that rather than treating my description of it as evidence.
response.rationale: Steers from echoed guidance to a bounded evidence comparison within the same project, without reopening the sleep mismatch.
